name: countonce
description: CountOnce: stock API, dashboard, staff app and Node-RED flows

scripts.predeploy: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('public/app/index.html') || (console.error('Run npm run build:app first, or the staff app disappears from the live site.'), process.exit(1))"
scripts.build:app: cd app && flutter build web --release --base-href /app/ && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('../public/app', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('build/web', '../public/app', { recursive: true, filter: (f) => !f.endsWith('.symbols') })"
